description.en: The ID of the application. Call the [ListApplication](~~149390~~) operation to obtain this ID.

description.zh: 配置自定义弹性行为，具体数据结构参考样例。
description.en: The configuration of custom scaling behaviors. For more information about the data structure, see the example.

description.zh:
弹性策略的启用状态。

- **true**：启用

- **false**：禁用
description.en:
The status of the Auto Scaling policy.

- **true**: enabled

- **false**: disabled
The name of the Auto Scaling policy.

description.zh: 触发器策略，为ScalingRuleTriggerDTO的JSON格式，具体样式，请参见请求参数补充说明。
description.en: The trigger policy, which is a JSON string of a ScalingRuleTriggerDTO object. For more information about the format, see the Additional information about request parameters section.

description.zh:
弹性策略类型，当前仅支持以下类型：
* trigger：触发器类型。
description.en:
The type of the Auto Scaling policy. Only the following type is supported:

- trigger: a trigger-based policy.

title.zh: 更新应用的弹性伸缩规则

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas update-application-scaling-rule --app-id 78194c76-3dca-418e-a263-cccd1ab40000 --scaling-rule-name cpu-trigger --scaling-rule-type trigger --scaling-rule-enable true --scaling-rule-metric 1 --scaling-rule-timer 1 --scaling-rule-trigger ScalingRuleTriggerDTO_...... --scaling-behaviour scaleUp_:_stabilizationWindowSeconds_:_0_,_selectPolicy_:_Max_,_policies_:_type_:_Pods_,_value_:5,_periodSeconds_:15_,_scaleDown_:_stabilizationWindowSeconds_:_300_,_selectPolicy_:_Max_,_policies_:_type_:_Percent_,_value_:200,_periodSeconds_:15 --region cn-hangzhou
